_doc: Committed synthesis-regression seed for `synapse eval-chat`. DISCIPLINE: every chat answer that is wrong at the SYNTHESIS layer (fabrication, refusal, wrong format) becomes a permanent labeled query here — never patch a single query. Each entry is a `CorpusQuery` (schema synapse.eval_chat.query.v1); the durable value is `checks` (require_substrings / forbid_substrings / forbid_refusal / min_sources), evaluated by `apply_output_checks` in eval_chat.py. `expected_source_ids` must be non-empty for the query to run (else run_eval skips it). Retrieval-class regressions (right note buried, garbage crowding) belong in memo `eval/regression_labels.json`, not here.
